name: vue-pointing-bubble
title: Vue Pointing Bubble
author: Alexey Murz Korepov
description: A Vue 3 callout whose SVG tail points exactly at coordinates or a DOM element.

files.content:
import PointingBubble from './PointingBubble.vue'

export type {
  Placement,
  ResolvedPlacement,
  TargetAnchor,
  Point,
  BubbleTarget,
  BubbleConfig,
  BubbleController,
  BubbleRenderState,
} from './core'

export {
  DEFAULT_BUBBLE_CONFIG,
  createBubbleController,
  resolveElement,
  isPoint,
  computeGeometry,
  buildTailPaths,
} from './core'

export { PointingBubble }
export { PointingBubble as default }

export type {
  Placement,
  ResolvedPlacement,
  TargetAnchor,
  Point,
  BubbleTarget,
  FrameRect,
  LocalRect,
  BoxMeasure,
  Geometry,
  Room,
  TailPaths,
  BubbleConfig,
  StyleMap,
} from './types'

export { DEFAULT_BUBBLE_CONFIG } from './types'

export { injectBubbleStyles, SHADOW } from './styles'

export { isPoint, resolveElement } from './resolveTarget'

export { sameKeys, measureFrame, measureBox } from './measure'

export { computeRoom, roomierSide, computeGeometry } from './geometry'
export type { ComputeGeometryOptions } from './geometry'

export { easeGeometry } from './ease'
export type { EaseHandle } from './ease'

export { buildTailPaths } from './tail'
export type { BuildTailOptions } from './tail'

export { createBubbleController } from './createBubbleController'
export type {
  BubbleRenderState,
  BubbleControllerOptions,
  BubbleController,
} from './createBubbleController'

export type Placement =
  | 'auto'
  | 'top-left'
  | 'top-right'
  | 'bottom-left'
  | 'bottom-right'
  | 'manual'

export type ResolvedPlacement =
  | 'top-left'
  | 'top-right'
  | 'bottom-left'
  | 'bottom-right'
  | 'manual'
  | 'none'

export type TargetAnchor = 'center' | 'edge'

export interface Point {
  x: number
  y: number
}

/** Core target: coords, DOM element, CSS selector, or null (box-only / in-flow). */
export type BubbleTarget = Point | Element | string | null

export interface FrameRect {
  left: number
  top: number
  width: number
  height: number
  scaleX: number
  scaleY: number
  viewportWidth: number
  viewportHeight: number
}

export interface LocalRect {
  left: number
  top: number
  right: number
  bottom: number
}

export interface BoxMeasure {
  x: number
  y: number
  width: number
  height: number
  fill: string
  stroke: string
  strokeWidth: number
  radius: string
  zIndex: string
}

export interface Geometry {
  placement: ResolvedPlacement
  tx: number
  ty: number
  bx: number
  by: number
  w: number
  h: number
}

export interface Room {
  left: number
  right: number
}

export interface TailPaths {
  fill: string
  stroke: string | null
}

export interface BubbleConfig {
  target: BubbleTarget
  placement: Placement
  targetAnchor: TargetAnchor
  maxWidth?: number
  tailLength: number
  tailBaseWidth: number
  padding: number | string
  shadow: boolean
  transitionDuration: number
}

export const DEFAULT_BUBBLE_CONFIG: BubbleConfig = {
  target: null,
  placement: 'auto',
  targetAnchor: 'center',
  tailLength: 45,
  tailBaseWidth: 24,
  padding: 8,
  shadow: true,
  transitionDuration: 200,
}

export type StyleMap = Record<string, string | number | undefined>
